create: CREATE TABLE "ads" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "ad_server_id" TEXT, "stored_ad_proto" BLOB, "rank" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "clusters" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "server_perm_id" TEXT, "cluster_config_proto" BLOB, "grouped_in_inbox" INTEGER, "write_sequence_id" INTEGER, "eviction_eligibility" INTEGER, "server_version" INTEGER, "type" INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE "entity_changes_to_sync_up" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "change_id" INTEGER, "change_proto" BLOB, "entity_type" TEXT, "entity_server_perm_id" TEXT)
CREATE TABLE "entity_sync_state" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "low_watermark" TEXT, "high_watermark" TEXT, "continuation_token" TEXT, "entity_name" TEXT)
CREATE TABLE "filters" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "server_perm_id" TEXT, "filter_proto" BLOB, "write_sequence_id" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "item_changes" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "change_type" INTEGER, "is_local_only" INTEGER, "items_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "items"("row_id"), "change_proto" BLOB, "change_state" INTEGER, "was_rolled_back" INTEGER, "change_order" INTEGER, "local_apply_time_ms" INTEGER, "has_fence_before" INTEGER, "has_fence_after" INTEGER, "applied_change" BLOB, "change_group_id" INTEGER, "server_version" INTEGER, "retryable_error_count" INTEGER, "next_retry_timestamp_ms" INTEGER, "acked_item_server_perm_ids" BLOB, "clusters_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "clusters"("row_id"), "local_apply_time_ms_2" INTEGER, "server_version_2" INTEGER, "next_retry_timestamp_ms_2" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "item_message_attachments" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "item_messages_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "item_messages"("row_id"), "is_synced" INTEGER, "attachment_url" TEXT, "attachment_cache_key" TEXT, "attachment_file_name" TEXT, "attachment_hash" TEXT, "message_synced_time_ms" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "item_message_doc_attachments" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "message_server_perm_id" TEXT, "doc_id" TEXT, "mime_type" TEXT, "message_received_time" INTEGER, "message_synced_time_ms" INTEGER, "resource_key" TEXT)
CREATE TABLE "item_message_tombstones" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "server_perm_id" TEXT, "write_sequence_id" INTEGER, "item_server_perm_id" TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "item_messages" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "server_perm_id" TEXT, "items_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "items"("row_id"), "message_proto" BLOB, "zipped_message_proto" BLOB, "is_missing_details" INTEGER, "write_sequence_id" INTEGER, "message_details_external_storage_id" TEXT, "is_invalidated" INTEGER, "legacy_storage_id" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "item_sync_reasons" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "items_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "items"("row_id"), "sync_reasons_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "sync_reasons"("row_id"), "subscription_rank" TEXT)
CREATE TABLE "item_tombstones" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "server_perm_id" TEXT, "write_sequence_id" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "item_visibility" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "items_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "items"("row_id"), "clusters_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "clusters"("row_id"), "view_type" INTEGER, "rank" TEXT, "cluster_rank" TEXT, "write_sequence_id" INTEGER, "do_not_show_before_timestamp_ms" INTEGER, "do_not_show_after_timestamp_ms" INTEGER, "nested_cluster_row_id" INTEGER, "display_timestamp_ms" INTEGER, "messages_in_view_bitmap" INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE "item_visibility_tombstones" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "view_type" INTEGER, "write_sequence_id" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "item_visibility_update_work" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "last_affected_item_row_id" INTEGER, "update_context" BLOB, "is_all_items_recalculation" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "items" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "server_perm_id" TEXT, "item_summary_proto" BLOB, "recurrence_id" TEXT, "hidden" INTEGER, "write_sequence_id" INTEGER, "server_version" INTEGER, "parent_server_perm_id" TEXT, "legacy_storage_id" INTEGER, "legacy_first_message_storage_id" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "items_sync_state" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "initial_sync_completed" INTEGER, "last_sync_time_ms" INTEGER, "low_watermark" INTEGER, "high_watermark" INTEGER, "highest_synced_version" INTEGER, "last_sync_targets" BLOB, "resync_in_progress" INTEGER, "last_per_label_items_sync_settings" BLOB, "last_entities_as_items_sync_settings" BLOB, "highest_synced_version_2" INTEGER, "initial_sync_start_time_ms" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "local_bulk_op_work" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "item_changes_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "item_changes"("row_id"), "work_type" INTEGER, "affected_item_server_perm_ids" BLOB, "remaining_affected_item_count" INTEGER, "has_items_to_create" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "pending_attachments" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "item_messages_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "item_messages"("row_id"), "attachment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_file_uri" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "upload_session_uri" TEXT NOT NULL, "upload_status" INTEGER, "pending_attachment_details" BLOB)

CREATE TABLE "settings" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "server_perm_id" TEXT, "settings_proto" BLOB, "is_dirty" INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE "sync_reasons" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "view_type" INTEGER, "clusters_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "clusters"("row_id"), "sync_reason_type" INTEGER, "server_version" INTEGER, "page_id" TEXT, "items_row_id" INTEGER REFERENCES "items"("row_id"), "server_version_2" INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE "system_properties" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "key" INTEGER, "property" BLOB)
CREATE TABLE "write_sequence_id" ("row_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY ON CONFLICT ABORT AUTOINCREMENT, "constant_key" INTEGER)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "IDXU_item_sync_reasons_items_row_id_asc_sync_reasons_row_id_asc" ON "item_sync_reasons" ("items_row_id" ASC, "sync_reasons_row_id" ASC)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "IDXU_sync_reasons_view_type_asc_clusters_row_id_asc_items_row_id_asc_sync_reason_type_asc_page_id_asc" ON "sync_reasons" ("view_type" ASC, "clusters_row_id" ASC, "items_row_id" ASC, "sync_reason_type" ASC, "page_id" ASC)
CREATE INDEX "IDX_item_visibility_view_type_asc_clusters_row_id_asc_rank_asc_items_row_id_asc" ON "item_visibility" ("view_type" ASC, "clusters_row_id" ASC, "rank" ASC, "items_row_id" ASC)
